data.description: Can be ground into a fine powder, requiring a DC 15 Knowledge (nature) or Profession (herbalist) check. When used in conjunction with the Craft (alchemy) skill, reduce the Craft DC by 5 and add +1 to the DC of any save required by the alchemical item. 1 leaf Augments crafting of 3 alchemical items.
